:::{#def-binary-symmetric-channel}
#### Binary symmetric channel

The **binary symmetric channel** with *crossover [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability)* $\epsilon \in [0, 1]$
is the [discrete memoryless channel](#def-channel)
with $\mathcal{X} = \mathcal{Y} = \{0, 1\}$ that
flips its [input](#def-channel) with [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) $\epsilon$:

$$
p(y \mid x) =
\begin{cases}
1 - \epsilon & \text{if } y = x, \\
\epsilon & \text{if } y \ne x.
\end{cases}
$$

:::
